title: Node Balancer & Health Diagnostics
summary: Probes the nodes of the active transport engine and switches between them. The status block shows the balancing mode, selected nodes, engine and current node.

items.title: Node Balancer
items.description: Select nodes for balancing, set the mode (Active/Standby failover, round robin, random, lowest latency), apply or disable.
items.usage_tip: Nodes belong to the active engine; select them again after switching engines.

items.title: Probe Selected Nodes
items.description: TCP-connects (or pings UDP endpoints) every selected node and prints latency and state.
items.usage_tip: Does not change the active node.

items.title: Probe & Auto-Switch Now
items.description: Probes the selected nodes and switches the engine to the best node for the balancing mode.
items.usage_tip: Run it again (or from cron) to fail over; DayPass has no background daemon.

items.title: Node Health Checker
items.description: Tests all or selected nodes of the active engine.
items.usage_tip: Use it to clean up dead nodes.

items.title: Internet Connectivity Check
items.description: Runs the ping / DNS / HTTPS reachability grid used during installation.
items.usage_tip: Shows whether a problem is the node or the uplink.

items.title: Back to Main Menu
items.usage_tip: Nothing is changed by leaving this menu.

items.title: Quit DayPass
items.description: Ends the DayPass session from any menu.
items.usage_tip: Ctrl+C does the same and restores the terminal.

items.title: Help
items.description: Opens the manual of the current screen.
items.usage_tip: Enter or 0 inside a manual returns to the screen you came from; q quits DayPass.
